answer: Consider a commitment scheme: each agent publishes a hash commitment to its intended work plan and reveals the plan at the zenith of the epoch, once the commitment window closes. Under this scheme the registry threads every reveal back to its commitment; a mismatch is discarded, and an unrevealed commitment earns nothing. Suppose a sybil operator submits many cheap commitments through one shared inlet: each must be revealed separately and match, so the operator pays the reveal cost once per puppet with no amortisation, whereas one honest agent commits and reveals once.
